note: Single source of truth for the NS-3 deployment-provenance pins (DR-001/NS-2,
PR #82): the SHA-256 digests of the two program ELFs whose bytes were
recorded from a deploy_devnet.sh-flow build of the approved tree, plus the
toolchain pins that produce byte-identical bytes.
Consumed by BOTH scripts/devnet/deploy_devnet.sh and the CI
'Verify ELF deployment provenance' step via scripts/devnet/ns3_check_provenance.mjs.
If a legitimate source/dependency/toolchain change shifts the ELF bytes, the
deployment gate STAYS CLOSED until the new build has been independently
reviewed and the new digests deliberately re-pinned here in a reviewed PR.
Never update a digest merely to make a build green.
